definition: Planned → work in progress → approved with green checks → merged, awaiting production verification → live with public readback. Blocked is a separate flag at any stage.
footer: Updates are reviewed with source changes. No estimated percentages or private operational data.
intro: Follow the work across Tuturuuu products. Every status links to public evidence.
missingEvidence: Migration completion evidence is not recorded; configuration alone does not prove completion.
note: Stages reflect recorded evidence at the observation time. Publication permission and successful builds do not prove live service.
stale: This snapshot is over 24 hours old. Check the linked evidence for newer updates.

summaries.live: Public production readback and acceptance match the merged migration source.
summaries.planned: A public migration target; implementation evidence is not recorded.
summaries.rolling_out: Source work or a current migration PR is recorded; completion is not verified.
summaries.waiting_for_merge: The current PR head is approved with all recorded required checks successful.
summaries.waiting_for_production_sync: The migration PR is merged into this source; production serving is not verified.

target: TanStack Start · Vite+ · Void · Cloudflare Workers
